channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Capital goods & infra in Indian markets. Today: mixed (+0.3).

item.title: [+1] India, US aim to wrap up first phase of trade deal by next month's G20 Summit
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 10 reports from Telegraph India, BusinessLine, India Today and 4 more. Related: “India-Canada trade pact talks to conclude in December”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 6 Nov).

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Sunil Mittal bats for mobile tariff hikes, says Rs 10-12 a day affordable
item.description:
Signal: global trade barriers (global). 4 reports from Fortune India, India Today, The Times of India and 1 more. Related: “‘Stop them or tariffs will be doubled’: Trump warns Mexico as 1,500 migrants head towards US”. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Slower world trade

Why it matters: Tariff escalation between major economies slows world trade and demand for Indian exports, though some supply chains may shift towards India.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
